name: Toyota F
notes: The original Land Cruiser inline-6 (1949-1975), carbureted, no ECU. Output varied by market/year (95-125hp, 261-289Nm cited across sources) - 105hp/275Nm used as a representative middle figure. Superseded by the 2F in 1975; not set as any frame's primary stock_engine here since most FJ40/42/43/45/55/56 frames are already mapped to the later 2F for simplicity, but genuine early-production units ran this engine.
